profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: Software Engineer working on emails and notifications for Meta advertisers

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
Worked at Living Analytics Research Centre, a joint research centre of Carnegie Mellon University and Singapore Management University.
• As the first author, published 1 research paper at ACM DPH'19 and 1 demo paper at ACM WWW’20.
• Fine-tuned generative pre-trained language model GPT-2 on 1 million cooking recipe documents

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
BrainCo is a brain-machine interface start-up founded by Harvard scientists, located in Somerville, MA
• Designed the proof-of-concept experiments to correlate people’s attention level with brain wave signals
• Recruited 20+ volunteers across teams within the company to participate in electrophysiology (EEG) experiments

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Acer is one of the top personal computer vendors in the world, headquartered in Taiwan.
•	Developed a computer vision model (MobileNet, a light-weighted convolutional neural network) using Tensorflow to assess the quality of diabetic retinopathy images with an accuracy of 93%

projects.title: Attended the Kaggle contest: Corporación Favorita Grocery Sales Forecasting
projects.description:
• Conducted feature engineering and modelling on time series sales data (Time, Store, Item, Quantity)
• Final world ranking: 58/1675 (Top 4%); Won the Silver medal
